domains.name: Electrical
domains.description: Lumped electrical networks with voltage effort and current flow.

domains.name: Electromechanical
domains.description: Components that exchange power across electrical and rigid-body mechanical ports.

domains.name: Thermal
domains.description: Reserved taxonomy domain; Phase 1 does not provide a thermal solver.

domains.name: Thermoelectric
domains.description: Reserved intersection for components such as thermistors and Peltier devices.

categories.name: Resistor
constraints: Exactly two terminals in the ideal contract
Positive resistance
Passive sign convention
categories.description: Two-terminal component whose ideal constitutive law is Ohm's law.

categories.name: Capacitor
constraints: Positive capacitance
Stored energy must be nonnegative

categories.name: Voltage source
constraints: Explicitly declare supplied power
categories.description: Two-terminal component imposing an electrical potential difference.

categories.name: Electrical power converter
constraints: Every input and output rail is explicit
Conversion and loss approximations are declared
categories.description: A multiport electrical converter or driver whose rail-specific port contract is model-defined.

categories.name: Motor
constraints: At least two electrical terminals
The mechanical port is named shaft
Electrical plus mechanical power conservation
categories.description: Energy conversion between electrical terminals and a mechanical shaft.

categories.name: Inert rigid object
constraints: Positive mass
Positive planar moment of inertia
Geometry frame must be declared
categories.description: A non-actuated rigid mass represented in the planar Phase 1 mechanics domain.

categories.name: Wheel and contact
constraints: Positive rolling radius
Contact model states its slip approximation
categories.description: Rotational-to-translational wheel interface, including a declared contact approximation.

categories.name: Mechanical joint
constraints: Joint subtype must make its allowed degrees of freedom explicit
categories.description: Kinematic and power-conserving connection between rigid bodies.

categories.name: Sheet metal
constraints: Instantiation records material, thickness, and geometry
categories.description: Manufactured sheet stock or formed sheet component.

categories.name: Screw
constraints: Instantiation records thread standard, diameter, pitch, length, and head type

categories.name: Thermistor
constraints: Must implement electrical and thermal physics before simulation
categories.description: Temperature-dependent resistor reserved for a future thermal solver.

subcategories.name: Fixed resistor
subcategories.model_specificity: Resistance is a fixed uncertain parameter rather than an externally controlled quantity.
constraints: No control signal changes nominal resistance

subcategories.name: Ceramic capacitor
subcategories.model_specificity: A higher-fidelity model may add voltage and temperature coefficient parameters characteristic of ceramic dielectrics.
constraints: Document dielectric class when known

subcategories.name: Brushed DC motor
subcategories.model_specificity: Uses a single armature circuit with torque and back-EMF constants coupled to one rotating shaft.
constraints: Armature polarity and positive shaft rotation are declared

subcategories.name: Planar rigid body
subcategories.model_specificity: Restricts motion to two translations and one rotation while preserving planar kinetic energy.
constraints: Out-of-plane dynamics are outside the validity envelope

subcategories.name: Camera represented as rigid mass
subcategories.model_specificity: Adds camera-specific mass, inertia, center-of-mass, and enclosure geometry defaults while excluding optical physics.
constraints: Optics and image formation are outside Phase 1

subcategories.name: Driven wheel
subcategories.model_specificity: Couples an axle torque port to a longitudinal contact force using rolling radius and compliant slip dynamics.
constraints: Lateral and vertical tire dynamics are outside the ideal model

subcategories.name: Revolute joint
subcategories.model_specificity: Permits exactly one relative rotational degree of freedom with optional torsional stiffness and damping.
constraints: Port torques obey action-reaction

metadata.geometry_note: explicit rough envelope; replace with measured or catalog dimensions

metadata.policy: Reuse an existing node unless a materially more specific physical model justifies a subcategory.
